text.title: FreshDrop pitch for store partners, investor meeting, 10 September 2026
text.target: busy families in new Moscow districts
text.need: need groceries for the week without a shop trip
text.benefit: delivers a complete order in 2 hours
text.alt: supermarket delivery slots that are booked a day ahead
text.diff: picks live stock, so no item is missing
text.spoken: We bring the week's groceries in 2 hours, and every item on the list is in stock. Families in new districts order in 3 taps.
text.check: Tested on 6 parents: 5 retold it correctly; the question was about refunds
text.decision: Keep the 2-hour line; add refund terms to the deck. Investor meeting: next step is a pilot budget review
